basic_info.description: Fantastic corner building with 3 units and 3 car parking garages. 2 of the units and all three parking spaces will be delivered vacant at close of escrow. The lower 2 units are 1BD/1BA units and will be delivered vacant at close of escrow. The upper unit is 3BD/1BA unit is rented with stable income. All three garage spaces will also be delivered vacant. Small shared garden in the back. Great for owner/investor looking to occupy one unit and rent the others. Close proximity to UCSF. Within walking distance to Ocean Ave restaurants, groceries, and Muni line as well as easy access to 280 freeway.
